title: Clearspace
slide_intent: Teach designers to reserve space around a logo and check it at small sizes. Both choices help a viewer distinguish the mark from nearby information.
strategic_value: A shared clearance rule can preserve the prominence of the Bolt wordmark on crowded screens.
demonstration: A large diagram marks the surrounding area in units of 1x and includes a small mark labeled 30 pt. Two lower examples place the mark in dark and light interface contexts.
practical_value: Measure the clearance against the indicated unit and check the small-size example before inserting the mark into a narrow header.
